title: nth counts from 0 and the agent is told so where it reads it; look.set's answer names the element it matched and its place among the matches
steps: S1: From packages/tools/tracy-site-tools run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/look-style.test.mjs test/look-set.test.mjs test/site-context.test.mjs
S2: Read the tests named in run.tests.
expect: findTarget refuses nth past the matches with '… so there is no #1 (nth counts from 0: the first is 0)', and page.look's refusal keeps that hint whole; styleRequest's next and the page.look call in the tracy_site description (wordpress, joomla, emdash) say 'nth?:0 = the first'.

look.set {target:{text:'Start a conversation', nth:1}} on two matches answers element '<a#mod-custom-233.btn.btn-primary> "Start a conversation" — match 2 of 2 (nth:1; nth:0 is the first)'; one match reads '— the only match', a partial one '— the closest partial match of the words'; a refusal after the read names the element too; LOOK_SET_CALL says 'nth?:0 = the first'.
The LOOK line of the site context (Joomla and WordPress) shows look.set's target as '{text|selector, nth?:0 = the first}'.

selectors.code: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/look-set.mjs matchedElement, LOOK_SET_CALL; look-style.mjs findTarget, BAD_STYLE_NEXT; site-context.mjs LOOK_SET; surface.mjs picturesBlock

evidence: dskeepwp / dskeepjo 09–10/10/2026: the agent passed nth:1 for 'the first button' three times — a failed call on WordPress T3, the second 'Start a conversation' (#mod-custom-233) changed instead of the hero's on Joomla T3, the wrong button then a self-revert on Joomla T4b.
fence: the call shape says nth is 0-based, and the write's receipt shows which element and which match it hit

tests: 🔒 nth counts from 0, and every place the agent reads it says so
🔒 the receipt names the element it matched and its place
